caseName: Adult Film Ass'n of America v. Lucas
caseNameFull: Adult Film Association of America v. Lucas, U. S. District Judge (Saxbe, Attorney General of the United States, Real Parties in Interest)

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. Certiorari denied. Mr. Justice Douglas, being of the view that any federal ban on obscenity is prohibited by the First Amendment (see United States v. 12 200-ft Reels of Film, 413 U. S. 123, 130 (1973) (Douglas, J., dissenting)), would grant certi-orari and reverse the judgment below.
